name: 94564 · Pinole, CA
findings: ZIP 94564 (Pinole) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94564 (Pinole) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94564 (Pinole) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
